Scottsdale to Oro Valley and northwest Tucson

Northwest Tucson and Oro Valley (85704) showcase the Sonoran Desert at its most beautiful, with the Santa Catalina Mountains providing a dramatic backdrop to world-class resorts, championship golf, and outdoor recreation. Catalina State Park and nearby Biosphere 2 add natural and scientific attractions. Our transportation connects Phoenix travelers to this stunning desert landscape.
